title: Does Calibration Survive Reasoning? Tracking Coherence Before vs After Chain-of-Thought

original_idea.body:
# Does Calibration Survive Reasoning?

Elicit probabilities with/without CoT; compute calibration and coherence in both conditions.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to agent-foundations coherence but the link to a concrete catastrophic scenario is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only probability elicitation with standard calibration metrics; accessible.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Calibration/internal-consistency work exists; the before-vs-after-CoT framing may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Related calibration work exists; the coherence-before-vs-after-CoT angle may be open.
